## Design and usability

- `ui-design` — Shape an interface around its content, tasks, and product identity.
- `responsive` — Fix reflow and access across widths and enlargement.
- `accessibility` — Review or improve keyboard, focus, semantics, and perceivable states.
- `mobile-web` — Fix touch, viewport, keyboard, and mobile browser behavior.
- `ui-stress` — Exercise realistic content extremes and task states.
- `prototype` — Compare UI directions or explore business rules in an isolated demo.
- `ui-library` — Choose components for a concrete capability gap.

## Build motion

- `animate` — Implement web transitions, gestures, and feedback.
- `animate-native` — Implement React Native or Expo motion and gestures.

## Understand and improve motion

- `animation-vocabulary` — Name an observed effect and distinguish similar motion.
- `animation-opportunities` — Identify useful places to add motion.
- `animation-review` — Review a selected interaction or motion change.
- `animation-audit` — Inventory motion across a project and prioritize improvements.
- `animation-debug` — Diagnose jumping, flickering, delayed, or stuck motion.
- `animation-performance` — Measure and improve frame pacing and responsiveness.
